shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone wall surface
small-scale motifs including recognizable creature/animal signs (in B, pictorial script glyphs; in A, animals)
justification: A depicts a narrative procession scene: bearded human figures in profile leading horned rams and a large fleecy animal, above a border band of rosettes; B depicts only rows of small abstract/pictographic signs arranged as continuous lines of text with no scene, figures interacting, or ornamental border. The only real correspondence is the shared use of shallow relief carving with elements aligned in horizontal registers, which is generic, and possibly the presence of small creature-like glyph shapes in B versus fully modelled animals in A.
